name: v100
description: NVIDIA Tesla V100 SXM2 (GV100, Volta, sm_70) at its 1530 MHz boost clock: one Vortex core per SM.

sources.NUM_CORES, NUM_WARPS, NUM_THREADS, ISSUE: 80 SMs, 64 resident warps/SM, 4 processing blocks with one scheduler each (NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU Architecture whitepaper, Table 1)
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 6 MB L2 (whitepaper), rounded down to the power of two the cache accepts; 16 ways, 32 banks for the 32 memory channels
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 4 HBM2 stacks x 8 128-bit channels = 32 channels at 1752 MT/s: 32 x 16 B x 1752 MT/s = 897 GB/s (whitepaper)
sources.FETCH_WIDTH: 4 SM processing blocks, each with its own warp scheduler, dispatch unit and L0 instruction cache (NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU Architecture whitepaper)
sources.CP_LLC_CLIENT: Host copies reach device memory through the L2 like every other client, so uploaded data is L2-resident at launch
